title: PulseDropHead
description: After a player dies, their head can drop! Customize everything as you like.
body:
# PulseDropHead

Player head drops on death for Paper/Purpur/Pulse 1.21.11+

---

## Features

- **Drop Modes** - PvP only, PvE only, or all deaths
- **Drop Chance** - 0-100% configurable
- **Glowing Heads** - 15+ colors, custom duration
- **Auto-Despawn** - Prevent lag
- **Multi-Language** - Russian & English
- **Pulse Optimized** - Auto packet batching on Pulse(Someday on Modrinth)
- **Cross-Platform** - One JAR for Paper/Purpur/Pulse(Someday on Modrinth)

---

## Commands

```
/pulsedrophead givehead <player> <head_owner>
/pulsedrophead lang <ru|eng>
/pulsedrophead reload
```

Alias: `/pdh`

All commands require OP.

---

## Config Example

```yaml
language: eng
drop-mode: pvp  # pvp, pve, or all
drop-chance: 100.0
head-display-name: "Head %player%"

glowing:
  enabled: false
  color: "WHITE"
  duration-seconds: 30

despawn:
  enabled: true
  time-seconds: 300
```

---

## Drop Modes

- `pvp` - Only player kills
- `pve` - Only environment deaths
- `all` - Any death

---

## Glow Colors

WHITE, RED, BLUE, GREEN, YELLOW, AQUA, GOLD, DARK_RED, DARK_BLUE, DARK_GREEN, DARK_AQUA, DARK_PURPLE, LIGHT_PURPLE, GRAY, DARK_GRAY, BLACK

---

## Requirements

- Paper/Purpur/Pulse 1.21.11+
- Java 21+

---

## Installation

1. Download JAR
2. Put in `plugins` folder
3. Restart server
4. Edit `config.yml`
5. Done

---

## Support

GitHub: https://github.com/ExRizzve/PulseDropHead-Plugin
